snippet.title: CHILL & REEL OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description: A cozy idle fishing game where you play as an adorable alligator angler. Designed to run in the corner of your screen, it's the perfect companion for work or study—featuring rich animations that make every moment feel like watching a charming short film.
